title: Admin Candidate Review List Navigation
problem: Durable Metadata Candidate Review detail/apply governance exists, but operators still need an item-scoped Admin API/Web way to discover review IDs and navigate into the existing detail/apply route.
gates: JSONL validation for docs/workstreams/admin-candidate-review-list-navigation/TASKS.jsonl, CAMPAIGNS.jsonl, and CONTEXT.jsonl
cargo nextest run -p nako-server candidate_review admin --no-fail-fast
browser smoke if a route or navigation mode is added

evidence.summary: Opened the Admin Candidate Review list/navigation lane from AWPDG closeout and selected a read-only item-scoped Admin API Candidate Review list as the first executable task.

Added the read-only Admin API item-scoped Metadata Candidate Review list route, redaction-safe list DTOs, synchronized generated Admin contracts, and server regression coverage for item scoping, no writes, and secret redaction.

Added Web Admin item-scoped Candidate Review list/navigation, route-state support for item_id/review_id/limit/offset, fixture/live data-source mapping, regression tests, and browser smoke coverage into the existing detail/apply route.
Closed the Admin Candidate Review list/navigation lane and split global Candidate Review queue/search, provider governance bulk review, and related hierarchy application into focused follow-ons.
